title: Union branches (anyOf)
description: anyOf support: an Optional[int]-shaped nullable field that collapses to a plain integer input, a 3-branch int | string | Address union, and a union nested inside an array row (a bare union directly as an array's `items` does not render a chooser — wrap it in an object property, as `rows.amount` does here).

optional_score.title: Optional score
optional_score.description: Pydantic Optional[int]: required (must be present) but nullable — leave it empty to submit null, and note there is no required asterisk despite being in "required".

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Reach them by phone extension, a free-text note, or a full mailing address — pick one.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Each row's amount is its own 2-branch union — switching a row's branch clears only that row.
